title: Fluctuations of the free energy of the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model with ferromagnetic interaction
summary: We study the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model with an additional Curie-Weiss ferromagnetic interaction (SKFI), whose phase diagram in the plane of the disorder strength $β$ and the ferromagnetic coupling $γ$ consists of a paramagnetic, a ferromagnetic, and a spin glass region. Our main result is a central limit theorem for the free energy in the ferromagnetic regime: at scale $N^{-1/2}$, the fluctuations coincide with those of the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model in an effective external field determined by the limiting magnetization.
